MONTHLY TECHNICAL REPORT - MARCH 2026
Reporting period: 1 March 2026 to 25 March 2026
Projects covered: ClearKamo Website, ClearKamo Admin Dashboard, Content Management Modules, and Platform Maintenance Tools
INTRODUCTION

This monthly report summarizes the technical activities completed and advanced during March 2026 for the ClearKamo website and administration platform. Work during the month focused on strengthening the public website experience, modernizing homepage presentation, improving content management through admin-driven modules, refining publication and inquiry workflows, and supporting platform stability through maintenance, upload, and navigation improvements.

CHALLENGES AND LESSONS LEARNED

March 2026 involved significant frontend and admin platform iteration. The main challenges were preserving layout quality across devices, balancing visual redesign with brand consistency, and keeping new admin-driven content workflows aligned with existing data structures.
Lessons learned:
- Stronger admin content control reduces dependency on code-level changes.
- Responsive navigation and overlay behavior require repeated real-device validation.
- Homepage visual improvements must still preserve readability and clear content hierarchy.
- Simpler forms and data models improve reliability for both users and administrators.
APRIL 2026 - PLANNED ACTIVITIES
Finalize responsive header, dropdown, and search behavior across all supported devices.
Continue homepage refinement and QA for visual sections, media blocks, and spacing consistency.
Extend admin usability improvements for publications, team content, and other dynamic sections.
Strengthen search, analytics, and reporting support for better operational monitoring.
Carry out further regression testing on upload, inquiry, and navigation workflows.
CONCLUSION

March 2026 has been productive for the ClearKamo platform. Major progress was made in homepage redesign, admin-managed content, publication workflow refinement, business inquiry handling, media presentation, and operational support features. These improvements have strengthened both the public-facing website and the administration environment, while also preparing the platform for further optimization in April.
